title: The lantern holds

Setting: the lighthouse lantern room: a huge faceted glass lens on a brass rotating lantern mechanism with a rusted gear drive assembly, framed by storm-streaked windows. Time and weather: clear golden morning, warm amber sunlight, calm sparkling ocean, gentle breeze.

Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
